name: Name
label: Label: {{code}}
codeHelp: Each color uses a unique letter (A–Z). Codes identify your colors; they do not prescribe a fixed palette.
gamutHelp: Generic to the current filament setup, not this upload.
kHelp: Optional pigment absorption gain (0 = plain Beer-Lambert). Calibrated presets carry fitted values; edit only if you know your material.
tdRgbHelp: Staircase-measured per-channel transmission distances (R, G, B). Same blend formula as the scalar td; per-channel data carries the measured selectivity.
tdPerChannelOff: Switch back to a single scalar transmission distance (uses the channel mean)
alphaSHelp: Scalar-form scatter coefficient alpha_s (paper Eq. 1). Neutral default ln(10) = 2.3026; calibrated presets carry fitted values.
tdScaleHelp: Scalar-form TD remap scale s_td (paper Eq. 2): td_eff = s_td * td^gamma_td. Neutral default 1.
tdGammaHelp: Scalar-form TD remap exponent gamma_td (paper Eq. 2). Neutral default 1.
